_comment: Checkpoints ship BF16 RMSNorm gains / affine scales+biases. Text weights live under `language_model.model.*`. Long-context family (>=128k); size the KV block table for 32k. The global attention class shares its on-disk projection/norm leaves with the sliding class (same disk tensor, wider head). The MoE sandwich norms ship on disk with trailing `_1`/`_2` (`post_feedforward_layernorm_1`, etc) — a trailing `_<digit>` in a DSL leaf is read as a LAYER INDEX (`translate_digit_suffix`), so the DSL names them `_dense`/`_moe` and renames to the digit leaves here (same workaround as LocateAnything's `linear_1`/`linear_2`). mlx sets `scale = 1.0` for BOTH attention classes. Rope scalars are nested per attention class under `rope_parameters`; `top_k_experts` is gemma's name for the canonical `num_experts_per_tok`.
